name: Kurita Water Industries Ltd.
summary: Kurita Water Industries Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides water treatment chemicals and equipment in Japan, rest of Asia, North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through Electronics Market and General Water Treatment Market segments. The company offers boiler water, cooling water, and wastewater treatment chemicals; water and wastewater treatment systems; maintenance services; ultrapure water supply; engineering, chemical, and physical cleaning; precision tool cleaning and recycling; operation and maintenance of water treatment facilities; soil and groundwater remediation and survey; and analysis and consigned testing services.
